spine_row.english: To summarize all these, bring to mind The description that our protector, Nagarjuna, Gives in his Letter to a Friend for a woman Who is one of high integrity. She should be as dear to our heart As a sister, and as pleasing as a good female friend. She should have the same desire to help us As our very own Mother possesses; And should be as self-controlled as a servant. A woman like this, He says, should be Honored like the goddess your family worships. * * * His Holiness the First Panchen Lama, Lobsang Chukyi Gyeltsen, discusses the best configuration of mind and body for partner practice in His Essence of the Ocean of Attainments: An Explanation of the Creation Stage of the Glorious Secret Collection (Guhya Samaja), King of All the Secret Teachings (ACIP digital text S00265, ff. 41b-42b):
